title: Watch Link Strap Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
The watch strap, without the watch. Five rows of polished gold tone links, set like brickwork, make a slim strap about 9mm wide that bends and follows the wrist the way a watch strap does. It is about 17cm long and about 2.5mm thick.

STYLING TIP: Wear it where a watch would sit, with the Watch Link Ring, or stack it with the Watch Link Bangle.

Details

  • Type: Flexible link bracelet; it bends and follows the wrist
  • Width: Approximately 9mm
  • Thickness: Approximately 2.5mm
  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Links: Five rows of polished links in a brick pattern
  • Stones: None
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
